name: freshbliss
description: FreshBliss: Firebase backend (firebase/) and Next.js storefront (web/). This file only holds the one-command local startup.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,seed,web --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,magenta "cd firebase && npm run emulators" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8080 && cd firebase && npm run seed" "cd web && npm run dev"
